title: Black Friday: the 7-point creative check
hook: Running Black Friday ads this weekend? Seven checks before you hit publish.
caption:
Running Black Friday ads this weekend? Seven checks before you hit publish.

Most sale ads slip on small things. The offer shows up late, or the page shows a different price from the ad.

These seven checks cover the ad, the click and what you will learn from it. They take a couple of minutes per ad.

The last slide has all seven in one place. Save it, run it on every ad going live, and have a good sale.

Follow @galvor.ai.
alt_text: Six-slide carousel. Slide 1: seven checks before your Black Friday ads go live. Slide 2: three checks on the offer, first frame, sound off, end date. Slide 3: two checks on the click, the landing page and stock. Slide 4: two checks on learning, one clear difference per ad and a written expectation. Slide 5: all seven checks on one slide in two columns. Slide 6: good luck this weekend, follow @galvor.ai.

slides.headline: *7 checks* before your Black Friday ads go live
slides.sub: A couple of minutes per ad. Do it before you hit publish.

slides.headline: Can a stranger *get the offer* at a glance?
items: Offer is in the first frame, not the last
Discount reads clearly with the sound off
End date is on screen and in the caption

slides.headline: Does the page *keep the promise*?
items: Landing page shows the same offer and price
The product in the ad is in stock

slides.headline: Will you know *why it worked*?
items: Each ad has one clear difference from the rest
You wrote down what you expect before launch

slides.headline: Have a good sale. *Check before you publish.*
slides.sub: Save this for every sale you run.
